confirmed_source_findings.title: Unknown delivery dates are presented as no scheduled delivery
confirmed_source_findings.mechanism: delivery_date is nullable. Missing/invalid/past dates leave nextDelivery null, but the outlook unconditionally translates null into None scheduled. The summary correctly preserves its next-delivery rawValue as unknown, making the two sections disagree about the same missing fact.
confirmed_source_findings.reproduction: Proposed source-case only, NOT executed: provide one PENDING order with delivery_date:null. The reducer leaves nextDelivery:null; the outlook selects None scheduled even though the delivery fact is unknown.
confirmed_source_findings.expected: Represent unknown/unconfirmed delivery facts distinctly from a proven absence of upcoming scheduled deliveries.
confirmed_source_findings.narrow_followup: Assign the delivery derivation and outlook owner a bounded unknown-versus-none correction; retain the summary's missing-value semantics and all five sections.

confirmed_source_findings.title: Cancelled orders can determine the next delivery
confirmed_source_findings.mechanism: The reducer counts cancellation separately but chooses the minimum future delivery timestamp from every row, without checking lifecycle. A cancelled row with the earliest future timestamp becomes the displayed next delivery.
confirmed_source_findings.reproduction: Proposed source-case only, NOT executed: at a clock before 2030-01-01, give CANCELLED with delivery_date 2030-01-01T12:00:00Z and PENDING with 2030-01-02T12:00:00Z. The source chooses the cancelled row's timestamp.
confirmed_source_findings.expected: Do not claim a terminal cancelled row is an upcoming handover; preserve the upstream record and explicitly define active delivery eligibility.
confirmed_source_findings.narrow_followup: Same bounded delivery-derivation owner as F1; cover cancellation/terminal rows without replacing status contracts.

confirmed_source_findings.title: Known row status labels bypass localization
confirmed_source_findings.mechanism: formatOrderStatus transforms the raw string using replacement/lowercasing but has no translator. Both row badge text and the card accessible name receive that English-derived output, while bucket labels separately use t.
confirmed_source_findings.reproduction: Proposed source-case only, NOT executed: choose a non-English locale and status DELIVERED or READY_FOR_DELIVERY. The formatter still returns Delivered or Ready for delivery regardless of translator/catalog.
confirmed_source_findings.expected: Localize supported known statuses and preserve unknown source values without inventing a translated lifecycle or silently recasing user-owned text.
confirmed_source_findings.narrow_followup: Assign the existing status formatter/card/table owners a known-status display mapping and report exact catalog needs to its serialized owner.

confirmed_source_findings.title: Text filtering uses raw status codes rather than displayed status text
confirmed_source_findings.mechanism: The external free-text filter explicitly searches raw status strings. Its display replaces underscores with spaces. Therefore an exact visible status phrase can eliminate the row that displays that phrase.
confirmed_source_findings.reproduction: Proposed source-case only, NOT executed: display a READY_FOR_DELIVERY row, then enter ready for delivery in Filter orders. Raw ready_for_delivery does not include the space-separated query; the row is removed.
confirmed_source_findings.expected: Search displayed/localized supported status text as well as stable raw values, keeping model/VIN/order-ID filtering and original source data.
confirmed_source_findings.narrow_followup: Bounded OrdersTable filter normalization correction, coordinated with F3's status-label mapping.

confirmed_source_findings.title: Section-local loading is not wired to the shared load announcement
confirmed_source_findings.mechanism: The page passes query/dataSources but omits loading, busy and its own load-announcement hook. PageContainer's announcement derives solely from Boolean(loading), not query. It therefore receives false throughout the initial query, so the shared hook cannot observe a loading-to-settled edge. Source notices still announce failure/paused states; this finding does not claim all page announcements are absent.
confirmed_source_findings.reproduction: Proposed source-case only, NOT executed: inspect a successful initial query transition from pending to ready. PageLayout props keep loading undefined before and after; PageContainer passes false both times; wasLoading.current && !isLoading is never true.
confirmed_source_findings.expected: Announce meaningful initial completion through the existing owner without using PageContainer loading to hide the independently rendered sections or duplicating source-notice announcements.
confirmed_source_findings.narrow_followup: Assign only TeslaOrdersPage's announcement/busy wiring and its authorized covering test; shared PageContainer/announcer remain read-only.

confirmed_source_findings.title: Table accessible name is an untranslated internal identifier
confirmed_source_findings.mechanism: OrdersTable supplies name="tesla-orders" and no caption. DataTable prioritizes caption ?? name ?? tableId for both aria-label and visually hidden caption. Localizing the enclosing panel heading does not replace that table name.
confirmed_source_findings.reproduction: Proposed source-case only, NOT executed: render in a non-English locale and inspect the table's accessible-name inputs. The selected value remains tesla-orders.
confirmed_source_findings.expected: Supply a localized human-readable caption while retaining the stable name/tableId persistence identities.
confirmed_source_findings.narrow_followup: Bounded OrdersTable caption adoption; do not rename tableId or storage identities.

candidates.title: Board minimum track width may exceed narrow allocated space
candidates.mechanism: minmax(18rem,1fr) cannot shrink below 18rem; at a 16px root that is 288px, and 200% root/text scaling can increase the minimum. Panel and shell allocations may be narrower.
candidates.required_proof: Native allocated-width/scrollWidth and focus/content captures at 320px and narrow containers, normal/scaled text. Actual shell gutters and composed overflow were not measured; no native overflow failure is asserted.

candidates.title: Filtered table hides four detail columns on mobile
candidates.mechanism: Only model/status remain table-visible below md. No mobilePresentation or row expansion is supplied. The separate unfiltered board preserves order ID, VIN, delivery and positive upgrade fields, so this is not proven page-wide data deletion.
candidates.required_proof: Native filtered-row detail reachability for large lists, repeated models and long identifiers; determine whether board access meets the intended filtered-table interaction before assigning a narrow mobile adapter fix.

candidates.title: Substring status classifier can imply delivery for unrecognized statuses
candidates.mechanism: AWAITING_DELIVERY or DELIVERY_SCHEDULED would reach includes('DELIVER') and become delivered unless an earlier token matches. This conditional transformation is source-visible, but the router proves no upstream status vocabulary.
candidates.required_proof: An authorized synthetic contract fixture representing an actually supported upstream status; do not invent production statuses, contact Tesla or classify this as an observed account defect.

candidates.title: Missing/malformed orders shape can collapse to false empty or throw outside section boundaries
candidates.mechanism: orders:null/missing uses [] for section empty but null stats for the brief; truthy nonarrays reach .filter before the summary's Array.isArray guard. Null rows are dropped by stats but not board/table. These inputs are outside the declared TeslaOrder[] shape.
candidates.required_proof: Backend JSON contract or an authorized malformed-payload fixture. No handler/model inspection beyond router was authorized; actual server nullability/completeness remains unknown.

candidates.title: Date-only/same-day and time-passing delivery semantics are unresolved
candidates.mechanism: Date.parse comparisons use an instant clock; YYYY-MM-DD parses at UTC midnight and may cease to qualify during its calendar day or display on a prior local day. Memoization recomputes nextDelivery only when the orders reference changes. The backend's actual delivery date granularity is not established.
candidates.required_proof: Authorized upstream date-format contract and synthetic frozen-clock/timezone cases; retain user's timezone/locale without guessing that a business calendar date is a timestamp.

candidates.title: Empty-panel refresh controls lack local pending feedback
candidates.mechanism: Imperative EmptyState action has label/onClick only, so these refresh buttons cannot receive disabled/loading props. The page single-flight ref protects requests, and the header does show pending feedback; therefore duplicate network actions are not inferred.
candidates.required_proof: Authorized synthetic interaction/announcement review to determine whether feedback is sufficiently reachable from each empty CTA. No mutation was executed.
